explication: Orkas is a local-first, multi-agent desktop app: a user describes a goal in chat, the Commander coordinates work across agents and tools, and the app returns files and other results on the user’s machine. The graph highlights that workflow plus connectors, marketplace skills, and office/media capabilities documented in the README. Several feature modules are present in the tree but were not sampled; their links are included only where the README documents the relationship, and the excerpts do not establish detailed renderer-to-main wiring.
